bio.text: Hank Johnson has represented Georgia's 4th Congressional District in the U.S. House since 2007 and sits on the House Judiciary Committee.
Before Congress he practiced law in Decatur, Georgia, for 27 years, served as a Magistrate Judge for 12 years, and was a DeKalb County Commissioner for five years.

He was born in Washington, D.C., and holds a B.A. in political science from Clark College (now Clark Atlanta University) and a J.D. from the Thurgood Marshall School of Law at Texas Southern University.
